table.name: Country
table.purpose: Lookup table of countries, one row per country, used to key leagues and matches (European football database).

col_001.name: country_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique numeric identifier for each country. Referenced by Match (home/away country columns) and by League, which stores both this id and its own league id.

col_002.name: name
col_002.description: Country name (e.g. England, Germany, Portugal); one per row, unique.

table.name: League
table.purpose: Lookup table of football (soccer) leagues/countries; one row per league, linked to its country and referenced by matches. Likely the European Soccer Database 'League' table (11 leagues).

col_001.name: league_id
col_001.description: Primary key of the league; unique integer identifier (e.g. 1729 = England Premier League). Referenced by Match (league/country columns).

col_002.name: country_id
col_002.description: Foreign key to Country.col_001 identifying the league's country; values match country ids (1729=England, 7809=Germany, 17642=Portugal, 21518=Spain, 24558=Switzerland).

col_003.name: league_name
col_003.description: Human-readable league name, e.g. 'England Premier League', 'Germany 1. Bundesliga', 'Portugal Liga ZON Sagres'.

table.name: Match
table.purpose: One row per professional football (soccer) match: teams, final score, lineups (player coordinates and player IDs), match event details as XML, and pre-match betting odds (home/draw/away) from multiple bookmakers. Covers European leagues, seasons 2008/2009-2015/2016.

col_001.name: match_id
col_001.description: Primary key, surrogate row id for the match (1..25979).

col_002.name: country_id
col_002.description: FK to Country; the country in which the match was played (11 countries, e.g. 1729=England, 21518=Spain).

col_003.name: league_id
col_003.description: FK to League; the league/competition of the match (11 leagues, e.g. 1729=England Premier League).

col_005.name: stage
col_005.description: Matchweek / round number within the season (1-38, consistent with league rounds).

col_007.name: match_api_id
col_007.description: External API id of the match; unique per row, distinct from the surrogate key.

table.name: Player
table.purpose: Soccer/football players master list (European football database): one row per player with identity, birth date, height and weight. Referenced by Player_Attributes (skill ratings) and Match (lineup player IDs).

col_001.name: player_row_id
col_001.description: Synthetic primary key, sequential 1..11075, one per player row.

col_002.name: player_api_id
col_002.description: External (API) player ID, unique per player; referenced by Player_Attributes and by the 22 lineup player columns in Match (home/away players 1-11).

col_003.name: player_name
col_003.description: Player's full display name (e.g. 'Anthony Martial'); not unique (10848 distinct for 11060 rows).

col_004.name: player_fifa_api_id
col_004.description: FIFA (game dataset) player ID, unique; referenced by Player_Attributes.col_002. Distinct ID space from col_002.

col_005.name: birthday
col_005.description: Player's date of birth (range 1967-1999, consistent with professional players).

col_006.name: height
col_006.description: Player height in centimeters, stored with two decimals (e.g. 182.88 = 6 ft); range 157.48-208.28 cm.

col_007.name: weight
col_007.description: Player weight in pounds (integers, range 117-243 lbs, mean ~168 lbs, consistent with soccer players' weights in lbs).

table.name: Player_Attributes
table.purpose: Time-stamped skill/attribute ratings for soccer players (FIFA-style ratings), one row per player per rating date. Links to the Player table via both a FIFA API id and a general API id.

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Surrogate primary key of the attribute record.

col_002.name: player_fifa_api_id
col_002.description: FIFA API identifier of the player; references Player.col_004 (many attribute rows per player).

col_003.name: player_api_id
col_003.description: General API identifier of the player; references Player.col_002 (many attribute rows per player).

col_004.name: date
col_004.description: Date the attribute ratings were recorded (2007-02-22 to 2016-07-07); repeated snapshots per player.

col_006.name: potential
col_006.description: Potential rating (upper bound of ability), 39-97; consistently >= overall rating.

col_008.name: attacking_work_rate
col_008.description: Attacking work rate: low/medium/high, with some dirty values ('None', 'norm', 'stoc', 'le').

col_009.name: defensive_work_rate
col_009.description: Defensive work rate: low/medium/high, with many dirty values ('_0', digits, 'es', 'o').

col_014.name: volleys
col_014.description: Volleys rating (1-93); slightly higher null rate.

col_016.name: curve
col_016.description: Curve rating (2-94); slightly higher null rate.

col_022.name: agility
col_022.description: Agility rating (11-96); slightly higher null rate.

col_024.name: balance
col_024.description: Balance rating (12-96); slightly higher null rate.

col_026.name: jumping
col_026.description: Jumping rating (14-96); slightly higher null rate.

col_033.name: vision
col_033.description: Vision rating (1-97); slightly higher null rate.

col_035.name: marking
col_035.description: Marking rating (1-96); mode at 25 suggests many low/NA-like values.

col_037.name: sliding_tackle
col_037.description: Sliding tackle rating (2-95); slightly higher null rate.

col_038.name: gk_diving
col_038.description: Goalkeeper diving rating (1-94); low values for outfield players.

table.name: Team
table.purpose: Soccer/football teams (European leagues), one row per team. Links to Match (home/away team) and Team_Attributes via the external team id, and to Country/League context via the broader database.

col_001.name: team_id
col_001.description: Surrogate primary key for the team row in this database; unique integer with no external meaning.

col_002.name: team_api_id
col_002.description: External API id of the team (e.g. from a football data provider). Referenced by Match home/away team columns and Team_Attributes.

col_003.name: team_fifa_api_id
col_003.description: FIFA/Electronic Arts (video game) team id; ~4% null, mostly small values with some large ones. Plausible alternative: another provider id, but the pattern (small ids plus a cluster of ~110k values) fits the FIFA-style id used in this dataset family.

col_004.name: team_long_name
col_004.description: Full, official team name (e.g. 'Villarreal CF', 'FC Utrecht'). A few names appear twice, likely distinct clubs sharing a name across eras/countries.

col_005.name: team_short_name
col_005.description: Short abbreviation of the team name, typically 3 letters (e.g. SIE for Siena, HIB for Hibernian); not unique across teams.

table.name: Team_Attributes
table.purpose: FIFA-style tactical/play-style attribute ratings for football teams, snapshotted at semi-annual dates (2010-2015). One row per team per rating date. Each play phase (build-up play, chance creation, defence) has a numeric rating (roughly 20-80) plus a categorical class label.

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Surrogate primary key of the team-attributes snapshot row.

col_002.name: team_fifa_api_id
col_002.description: FIFA (video game / EA) API id of the team; 285 distinct teams, some ids missing from the Team table.

col_003.name: team_api_id
col_003.description: External API id of the team; foreign key to Team (many snapshots per team).

col_004.name: date
col_004.description: Date the attribute snapshot was taken; six distinct dates, roughly Feb and Sep each year 2010-2015.

col_005.name: build_up_play_speed
col_005.description: Numeric rating (20-80) of build-up play speed.

col_006.name: build_up_play_speed_class
col_006.description: Class label for build-up play speed: Slow / Balanced / Fast.

col_007.name: build_up_play_dribbling
col_007.description: Numeric rating of build-up play dribbling; 66.5% null (not captured in early snapshots).

col_008.name: build_up_play_dribbling_class
col_008.description: Class label for build-up dribbling: Little / Normal / Lots.

col_009.name: build_up_play_passing
col_009.description: Numeric rating (20-80) of build-up play passing.

col_010.name: build_up_play_passing_class
col_010.description: Class label for build-up passing: Short / Mixed / Long.

col_011.name: build_up_play_positioning_class
col_011.description: Build-up play positioning: Organised / Free Form.

col_012.name: chance_creation_passing
col_012.description: Numeric rating (21-80) of chance creation via passing.

col_013.name: chance_creation_passing_class
col_013.description: Class label for chance creation passing: Safe / Normal / Risky.

col_014.name: chance_creation_crossing
col_014.description: Numeric rating (20-80) of chance creation via crossing.

col_015.name: chance_creation_crossing_class
col_015.description: Class label for chance creation crossing: Little / Normal / Lots.

col_016.name: chance_creation_shooting
col_016.description: Numeric rating (22-80) of chance creation via shooting.

col_017.name: chance_creation_shooting_class
col_017.description: Class label for chance creation shooting: Little / Normal / Lots.

col_018.name: chance_creation_positioning_class
col_018.description: Chance creation positioning: Organised / Free Form.

col_020.name: defence_pressure_class
col_020.description: Class label for defensive pressure: Deep / Medium / High.

col_022.name: defence_aggression_class
col_022.description: Class label for defensive aggression: Contain / Press / Double (team).

col_023.name: defence_team_width
col_023.description: Numeric rating (29-73) of defensive team width.

col_024.name: defence_team_width_class
col_024.description: Class label for defensive width: Narrow / Normal / Wide.

col_025.name: defence_defender_line_class
col_025.description: Defensive line behaviour: Cover / Offside Trap.
